entities.name: small figure (youth or child?) reaching to the man on the bank

Painted height 57 px against the man's 69 px beside it (0.83): a youth, a short adult or a child; the restyle paints a child in blue. Brief: the scan has three figures on this bank, two at u 14650-14700 (this one and S4b.fig.man_on_bank_14686) and the porter. BANK: stands on the light open ground north of the tea house (the gate roof S4b gate at u 14450-14600, v 490-640 is south-west of it); the ground's wash shading falls away east and south-east toward the boats' sterns (u 14830-14900, v 400-480). Forward (west) foot (14775, 400), rear foot (14793, 407). Painted height 61 px (bent). Facing from the stride and the lean of the torso; the head may be turned east (conf med). The restyle adds a kneeling figure hugging him (u 14760-14830, v 340-400) and figures heaped with bundles round a bench (u 14680-14830, v 400-480): the scan has neither. BANK: as S4b.fig.small_companion_14654; the boats' sterns begin about 50 px east of him (river agent). MERGE: his feet are at the bank end of S4b.veh.boat_mat_cargo_14900's gangplank (bank end (14760, 402), boat end (14895, 463)): he walks up from it, so he is a candidate for 余辉's 客家登船 (unloading or boarding), as is S4b.fig.man_on_bank_14928. SECOND PASS: facing changed from 180 to 330 (conf med). On an unsharpened zoom-6 crop his face is a dark profile under the cap on its EAST side (14783-14790, 355-363), his raised hand holds the pole in front of it at (14790-14798, 357-367), his head is east of his hips, and his east leg steps down-right to (14788, 405) along the gangplank ((14745, 388) to the boat end (14895, 463)). The river agent read him facing east; t4 read west from the stride. He is loading or boarding the mat-cargo boat (余辉's 客家登船?), not coming off it, so the MERGE note's "walks up from it" is superseded. Crops scratchpad S4b_second_east/z_porter_soft.jpg, z_porter.jpg.
